intro: 12 個合約情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: All contractors must abide by the site safety rules.
ex.zh: 所有承包商都必須遵守工地安全規則。

ex.en: We agreed to abide by the outcome of the arbitration.
ex.zh: 我們同意遵守仲裁結果。

note: 一定要接 by,不能說 abide the rules

ex.en: The two companies reached an agreement after months of talks.
ex.zh: 兩家公司經過數月談判後達成協議。

ex.en: Under the agreement, the supplier delivers within ten days.
ex.zh: 依照協議,供應商須於十天內交貨。

note: be in agreement with 與⋯意見一致

ex.en: He gave us his assurance that the shipment would arrive on time.
ex.zh: 他向我們保證貨物會準時抵達。

ex.en: She answered the client's questions with complete assurance.
ex.zh: 她非常有把握地回答客戶的問題。

note: insurance 是保險,只差一個字母

ex.en: The cancellation of the order cost the factory two weeks of work.
ex.zh: 訂單取消讓工廠損失兩週的產能。

ex.en: Please review the cancellation policy before booking.
ex.zh: 訂房前請詳閱取消政策。

note: 名詞雙 l,美式動詞過去式 canceled 單 l

ex.en: The audit will determine whether the fees were properly charged.
ex.zh: 稽核將查明費用是否收取得當。

ex.en: Market demand determines the final price.
ex.zh: 市場需求決定最終價格。

note: determination 決心;determined 有決心的

ex.en: The firm engaged a consultant to review the contract.
ex.zh: 公司聘請顧問審閱合約。

ex.en: Employees are encouraged to engage in training programs.
ex.zh: 公司鼓勵員工參與培訓課程。

note: engage in sth 自己投入;engage sb. in sth 讓別人加入
engagement 約定、訂婚;engaging 引人入勝的

ex.en: The company was established in Taipei in 1998.
ex.zh: 該公司於 1998 年在台北成立。

ex.en: The contract establishes clear payment terms.
ex.zh: 這份合約確立了明確的付款條件。

note: established in + 年份;a well-established firm 老字號

words.zh: 使負有法律或道義上的責任

ex.en: The agreement obligates both sides to share maintenance costs.
ex.zh: 該協議使雙方都有義務分攤維護費用。

ex.en: Employees are not obligated to work on public holidays.
ex.zh: 員工沒有義務在國定假日上班。

note: 幾乎只用被動:be obligated to + 原形動詞
obligation 義務;have an obligation to⋯

ex.en: Neither party may transfer the contract without written consent.
ex.zh: 未經書面同意,任何一方不得轉讓合約。

ex.en: Disputes will be settled by a neutral third party.
ex.zh: 爭議將由中立的第三方解決。

note: both parties 雙方;the parties concerned 相關當事人

ex.en: The contract includes a provision for early termination.
ex.zh: 合約中包含提前終止的條款。

ex.en: Under this provision, either side may renegotiate the price.
ex.zh: 依本條款,任一方均可重新議價。

note: 複數 provisions 另有「糧食補給」之意

ex.en: The two sides resolved the dispute without going to court.
ex.zh: 雙方未經訴訟就解決了爭議。

ex.en: She resolved to renegotiate the terms next quarter.
ex.zh: 她決心下一季重新談判條件。

note: resolve a problem 解決;resolve to V 決心

ex.en: Please be specific about the delivery date.
ex.zh: 請明確說明交貨日期。

ex.en: The manual gives specific instructions for installation.
ex.zh: 手冊提供了具體的安裝說明。

note: specify 指明;specification 規格;specifically 明確地
